name: moveToSpot
doc: when user asks you to move to a specific spot in the world, use this action. The parameter is the name of the spot. DO NOT use this if you want to move to environment objects

name: moveToPoint
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: when the user asks you to go to an arbitrary point in the world, use this action. The parameters are the x, y, and z coordinates of the point.

name: talk
doc: use this action when the user asks you something or where a comment to some other action is appropriate. The parameter is the text you want to say.

name: lookAt
doc: face a named spot or object

name: grab
doc: pick up a named object from the environment. DO NOT grab if npc has item via itemInRightHand: None/name field. Always move close enough to grab

name: place
args: x: float, y: float, z: float
doc: place on top of an environment object (above the bounding box). DO NOT place if npc has empty hand. Look if NPC itemInRightHand: None. Always move close enough to place
